title: The 1946 'New Orleans' film recording and Sidney Greenstreet's tails
summary: Moore recalls the film session in Hollywood, the costume tails, and the brown shoes painted black.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: I see. Well, Louie went into recording studios so many times during his life, I'm sure he didn't remember them but with that large orchestra,
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
that big band that he had in the mid-40s, he recorded in 1946 and you were involved in that recording for the RCA Victor Company, Victor Records.

Those records were the tunes out of the picture "New Orleans," you know what year that was made -- it was made in New Orleans. That was a wonderful experience, too, when we were in Hollywood in those studios. And one time one of the trumpet players who always loved brown shoes, so instead of wearing black shoes -- we were having tails and dark suits with tails and I remember everyone of us, we went over to a costume building where all the clothes for the movie stars were stored away until they need them. So they fitted me -- I was so big that they fitted me with tuxedo tails and right on the inside of the lapels it says, "Sidney Greenstreet." I'll never forget that. I wore Sidney Greenstreet movie tails. Anyway, when we were making the picture in New Orleans, I remember one time we were on a huge stage and the whole setup -- we were somewhere in Sweden -- and the director was right in front looking over the scenes, over the bandstand, looking at the bandstand, how it was going to look and all he did was come to this guy who liked these brown shoes. It was

not black, almost black but it was not black enough, it was somewhat on the dark brown side. So he spotted it right away, he called for black paint." And a guy in a uniform work there came up with paint and a brush, black paint. "Get that man over there, the third man from the corner there, on the end there, gotta get those shoes --" The paint man run up there and I saw him dip the brush in the paint and smeared all the black paint on the brown shoes and the guy was almost crying over his new shoes, they was painting them black. That was a funny incident. Everybody was laughing at him. He was wearing black tails and semi-brown shoes.
